review_notes: Round 4 re-review. All 43/43 unit tests pass, ruff clean, 6 files formatted.

Issue 1 (AC-4 git spec gap): docstring documents image-level git blocking. Test confirms docstring mentions 'container image' and 'git'. Design is intentional — local git commands cannot be blocked by network policy and git-absent images are the correct approach. Resolved.

Issue 2 (create() deep module): create() extracted into 5 private helpers (_build_env, _build_labels, _build_host_config, _create_and_start_container, _extract_port). create() is now 15 lines. Resolved.
Issue 3 (private _egress_policy): public egress_policy property added. Tests use sandbox.egress_policy consistently. Resolved.
Issue 4 (broad except Exception): narrowed to (KeyError, TypeError, IndexError, AttributeError). Resolved.

All 8 acceptance criteria addressed: create/destroy/list/is_running (DockerSandbox), PyPI reachable + arbitrary internet blocked (EgressPolicy with configurable allowlist logged on startup), git commands blocked at image level, runsc with fallback to plain Docker.
